arguments.sql:
WITH customer_bounds AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(txn_date) AS first_day,
           MAX(txn_date) AS last_day,
           COUNT(DISTINCT txn_date) AS transaction_days
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
daily_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers,
    MIN(txn_date) AS earliest_day,
    MAX(txn_date) AS latest_day,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT txn_type) AS transaction_types,
    SUM(txn_date IS NULL OR date(txn_date) IS NULL OR txn_date <> date(txn_date)) AS invalid_dates,
    SUM(customer_id IS NULL OR txn_type IS NULL OR txn_amount IS NULL) AS missing_fields,
    MIN(txn_amount) AS minimum_amount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_counts WHERE transactions > 1) AS multi_transaction_days,
    (SELECT MAX(transaction_days) FROM customer_bounds) AS most_transaction_days,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', first_day)) FROM customer_bounds) AS distinct_baseline_months,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_bounds WHERE last_day < (SELECT MAX(txn_date) FROM main.customer_transactions)) AS customers_ending_before_latest_day,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.customer_nodes WHERE end_date = '9999-12-31') AS customers_with_open_node_assignment
FROM main.customer_transactions

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           txn_date AS balance_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_starts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(balance_date) AS first_day
    FROM daily_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
reporting_end AS (
    SELECT MAX(balance_date) AS last_day
    FROM daily_changes
),
customer_days(customer_id, balance_date, baseline_month) AS (
    SELECT customer_id, first_day, strftime('%Y-%m', first_day)
    FROM customer_starts

    UNION ALL

    SELECT customer_id, date(balance_date, '+1 day'), baseline_month
    FROM customer_days
    WHERE balance_date < (SELECT last_day FROM reporting_end)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.balance_date,
           c.baseline_month,
           SUM(COALESCE(d.net_change, 0)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.customer_id
               ORDER BY c.balance_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS running_balance
    FROM customer_days AS c
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS d
        ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
       AND d.balance_date = c.balance_date
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           balance_date,
           strftime('%Y-%m', balance_date) AS month,
           baseline_month,
           COUNT(*) OVER trailing_30_days AS days_in_window,
           AVG(running_balance) OVER trailing_30_days AS average_balance
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW trailing_30_days AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY balance_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
last_transaction AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MAX(balance_date) AS last_transaction_day
    FROM daily_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_month_comparison AS (
    SELECT r.customer_id,
           r.month,
           r.baseline_month,
           MAX(MAX(r.average_balance, 0.0)) AS full_period_max,
           MAX(CASE WHEN r.balance_date <= t.last_transaction_day
                    THEN MAX(r.average_balance, 0.0) END) AS through_last_transaction_max
    FROM rolling_balances AS r
    JOIN last_transaction AS t ON t.customer_id = r.customer_id
    WHERE r.days_in_window = 30
    GROUP BY r.customer_id, r.month, r.baseline_month
)
SELECT month,
       COUNT(*) AS customers_with_complete_windows,
       SUM(month = baseline_month) AS baseline_customers,
       SUM(full_period_max = 0.0) AS zero_max_customers,
       SUM(full_period_max) AS total_through_dataset_end,
       COUNT(through_last_transaction_max) AS customers_through_last_transaction,
       SUM(through_last_transaction_max) AS total_through_last_transaction
FROM customer_month_comparison
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
